"""A test that reports success for a run that did nothing.

On a machine with a display it runs. On the headless machine #19 is about, it
skips, the suite is green, and nothing anywhere says the assertion was not made.
"""

import os
import unittest


class ThePlotIsProduced(unittest.TestCase):
    @unittest.skipUnless(os.environ.get("DISPLAY"), "needs a display server")
    def test_the_figure_renders(self):
        self.assertTrue(True)
